THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Theology Proper
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The study of the being, attributes, and works of God.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 1, card 1

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Knowable
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The fact that we can know true things about God, and that we can know God himself and not simply facts about him.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 1, card 2

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Aseity
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: Another name for the attribute of God's independence or self-existence.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 1, card 3

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Communicable Attribute
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: Aspects of God's character that he shares or communicates with us.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 1, card 4

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Incommunicable Attribute
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: Aspects of God's character that God does not share with us.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 1, card 5

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Omnipresence
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The doctrine that God does not have size or spatial dimensions and is present at every point of space with his whole being, yet God acts differently in different places.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 1, card 6

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Eternity
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The doctrine that God has no beginning, end, or succession of moments in his own being, and sees all time equally vividly, yet sees events in time and acts in time.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 1, card 7

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Impassibility
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The belief that God is incapable of suffering harm in the sense that his being cannot be changed or harmed by anything outside of himself.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 1, card 8

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Christology
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The study of Christ.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 1, card 9

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Faithfulness
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The doctrine that God will always do what he has said and fulfill what he has promised.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 1, card 10

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Goodness
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The doctrine that God is the final standard of good, and that all that God is and does is worthy of approval.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 1, card 11

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Theophany
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: An appearance of God in which he takes on a visible form to show himself to people.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 2, card 12

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Trinity
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The doctrine that God eternally exists as three persons—Father, Son, and Holy Spirit—and each person is fully God, and there is one God.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 2, card 13

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: In the Holy Spirit
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The state of consciously dwelling in an atmosphere of God's manifested presence.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 2, card 14

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Angel
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: A created spiritual being with moral judgment and high intelligence, but without a physical body.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 2, card 15

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Archangel
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: An angel with authority over other angels.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 2, card 16

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Seraphim
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: A class of created spiritual beings that are said to continually worship God.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 2, card 17

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Pneumatology
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The study of the Holy Spirit.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 2, card 18

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Sons of God
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: Another name for angels (Job 1:6; 2:1)
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 2, card 19

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Blasphemy against Holy Spirit
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The unusually malicious, willful rejection and slander against the Holy Spirit's work attesting to Christ, and attributing that work to Satan.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 2, card 20

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Demon possession
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: A misleading phrase found in some English translations of the Bible that seems to suggest that a person's will is completely dominated by a demon. The Greek term δαιμονίζομαι (G1227) is better translated 'under demonic influence,' which could range from mild to strong influence or attack.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 2, card 21

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Satan
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The personal name of the head of the demons.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 3, card 22

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Demons
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: Evil angels who sinned against God and who now continually work evil in the world.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 3, card 23

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Living creature
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: A class of created spiritual beings with appearances like a lion, an ox, a man, and an eagle, who are said to worship around the throne of God.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 3, card 24

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Hypostatic Union
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The union of Christ's human and divine natures in one person (from the Greek hypostasis, 'being')
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 3, card 25

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Kenosis Theory
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The theory that Christ gave up some of his divine attributes while he was on earth as a man.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 3, card 26

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Propitiation
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: A sacrifice that bears God's wrath to the end and in so doing changes God's wrath toward us into favor.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 3, card 27

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Filled With the Holy Spirit
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: An event subsequent to conversion in which a believer experiences a fresh infilling with the Holy Spirit that may result in greater love for God, greater victory over sin, greater power for ministry, and sometimes the receiving of new spiritual gifts.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 3, card 28

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Impeccability
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The doctrine that Christ was not able to sin.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 3, card 29

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Atonement
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The work Christ did in his life and death to earn our salvation.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 3, card 30

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Penal Substitution
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The view that Christ in his death bore the just penalty of God for our sins as a substitute for us.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 3, card 31

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Spirit
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The immaterial part of man, a term used interchangeably with 'soul.'
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 4, card 32

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Incarnation
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The act of God the Son whereby he took to himself a human nature.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 4, card 33

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Impute
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: To think of as belonging to someone, and therefore to cause it to belong to that person. God thinks of Adam's sin as belonging to us, and in justification he thinks of Christ's righteousness as belonging to us.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 4, card 34

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Incorruptible
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The nature of our future resurrection bodies, which will be like Christ's resurrection body and therefore will not wear out, grow old, or be subject to any kind of sickness or disease.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 4, card 35

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Bibliology
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The study of the teaching of the individual authors and sections of the Bible and of the place of each teaching in the historical development of the Bible.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 4, card 36

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Canon
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The list of all the books that belong in the Bible.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 4, card 37

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: God-breathed
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: A translation of the Greek theopneustos, which the Bible uses metaphorically to describe the words of Scripture as being spoken by God.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 4, card 38

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Perspicuity
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: An older term for the clarity of Scripture.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 4, card 39

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Plenary inspiration
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The idea that all the words of Scripture are God's words, with plenary meaning 'full.'
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 4, card 40

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Scripture
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The writings of the Old and New Testaments, which have historically been recognized as God's words in written form. Another term for the Bible.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 4, card 41

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Sufficiency
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The idea that Scripture contained all the words of God he intended his people to have at each stage of redemptive history, and that it now contains all the words of God we need for salvation, for trusting him perfectly, and for obeying him perfectly.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 5, card 42

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Self-attesting
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The self-authenticating nature of the Bible by which it convinces us that its words are God's words.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 5, card 43

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Inerrant
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The idea that Scripture in the original manuscripts does not affirm anything that is contrary to fact.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 5, card 44

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Clarity
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The idea that the Bible is written in such a way that its teachings are able to be understood by all who will read it seeking God's help and being willing to follow it.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 5, card 45

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Infallible
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The idea that Scripture is not able to lead us astray in matters of faith and practice.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 5, card 46

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: General revelation
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: The knowledge of God's existence, character, and moral law that comes through creation to all humanity.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 5, card 47

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Special revelation
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: God's words addressed to specific people, including the words of the Bible. This is to be distinguished from general revelation, which is given to all people generally.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theo Quiz 1-4 Gifford, PDF p. 5, card 48

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Theology Proper Verse 2

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Quiz 1 Verse: 2 Timothy 3:14-17
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: But as for you, continue in what you have learned and have firmly believed, knowing from whom you learned it and how from childhood you have been acquainted with the sacred writings, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus. All Scripture is breathed out by God and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in righteousness, that the man of God may be complete, equipped for every good work.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theology I BTH 321 syllabus, Memory Verse Quizzes, p. 5 (Quiz 1)

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Quiz 2 Verse: Psalm 73:25-26
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: Whom have I in heaven but you? And there is nothing on earth that I desire besides you. My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theology I BTH 321 syllabus, Memory Verse Quizzes, p. 5 (Quiz 2)

THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.title: Quiz 3 Verse: 1 Corinthians 15:20-23
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.body: But in fact Christ has been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep. For as by a man came death, by a man has come also the resurrection of the dead. For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ shall all be made alive. But each in his own order: Christ the firstfruits, then at his coming those who belong to Christ.
THEOLOGY_QUIZ4_DATA.source: Christian Theology I BTH 321 syllabus, Memory Verse Quizzes, p. 5 (Quiz 3)
